text: Seventeen dollars a visit. A ten dollar pass existed.
Your gym membership. Feeling it yet?
Researchers followed almost eight thousand members at three US gyms, for three years.
Monthly members paid over seventy dollars a month.
But they went about four point eight times a month.
That's over seventeen dollars a visit, when a ten dollar visit pass was right there.
And after their last visit, they kept paying for over two months before cancelling.
Money left on the table: about seven hundred dollars each.
We pay for the person we plan to be.
So count your visits. Then pay for the person you are.
